title: 早发白帝城
author: Li Bai

translation: At dawn I leave Baidi City, high among rosy clouds
A thousand li to Jiangling, covered in a single day
Monkeys on both banks cry without pause
My light boat has already passed ten thousand ranges

annotations.白帝城: Baidi City, a fortress on a mountaintop overlooking the Yangtze gorges
annotations.猿: gibbon — their cries were famous along the Three Gorges

appreciation: Li Bai wrote this in 759, sailing down the Yangtze right after receiving a pardon from exile — the speed of the boat is the speed of his relief. A thousand li in one day is impossible, but joy doesn't do arithmetic. The wailing gibbons can't even keep up; before their cry fades, the mountains are already behind him.
